value: Above the Dead Scar, Madrigosa challenges Brutallus. The pit lord strikes the blue dragon down, and her fall dims the defenders’ hopes. Yet the fel blood spilled from Brutallus will not leave her body in peace.
editorNote: Brutallus’s kill and Madrigosa’s role are secondary transcript/article locators pending original-client review. Record remains research. Original-client and human source review are still required; no record is promoted to reviewed or published.
